what: During the traceability audit, recompute_prereg_oct21_22nd.py (the executor of the pre-specified P1_disclosure_oos test, not an offline recomputation) was run by mistake together with the offline recomputation scripts.
effect: The script incremented P1_disclosure_oos_unlocks.json to n=2, then tried to download the 627 test symbol-days. Network access is blocked in this environment and no cache exists, so it built 0 valid symbol-days and stopped with KeyError 'split' before any statistic was computed. No test data were loaded and no result was produced or viewed.
action: Unlock file restored to its committed state (n=1, unlocked 2026-10-21T15:49:05Z). The follow-up executor (recompute_prereg_oct21_followup.py) was stopped before it reached its unlock step; its unlock file is unchanged. The paper's result remains the single October 2026 evaluation.
prevention: The audit note marks the two executor scripts as data-downloading test runners that must not be run as recomputations.
